# MediaPipe Tasks Vision (local runtime)

- Package: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.21`, pinned, unmodified JS/WASM.
- Runtime source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.21/
- Upstream: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/tree/v0.10.21
- Hand model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
- MediaPipe license: Apache 2.0, included in `LICENSE`.
- Package README is retained as `README.upstream.md`.
- `SHA256SUMS` records the vendored artifacts for integrity checks.

These files are served from this project. Runtime does not load a CDN or upload camera frames.
